question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, add up BC-20's weak, medium and strong CO2-TPD site densities. Does the sum match the cumulative weak-to-strong value the paper reports for BC-20?
rendered:
The sum of the weak, medium, and strong CO2-TPD site densities for BC-20 is 1.0430 mmol g−1 (weak) + 2.0180 mmol g−1 (medium) + 1.9227 mmol g−1 (strong) = 5.9837 mmol g−1. 

The cumulative weak-to-strong CO2-TPD site density below 400 °C for BC-20, reported in the paper, is 4.984 mmol g−1. 

The sum of the weak, medium, and strong site densities for BC-20 does not match the cumulative weak-to-strong value reported in the paper.
